title.narrative: AI and ICT to foster inclusive, sustainable, and equitable learning environments

description.narrative: The collaboration between JP SA Couto and UNESCO IITE focuses on addressing educational challenges in Kenya by integrating AI and ICT to foster inclusive, sustainable, and equitable learning environments. This initiative aims to empower educators through specialized capacity building initiatives focused on digital inclusion, advanced ICT and AI practices, and greening education. Key activities delivering tailored training courses, organizing impactful webinars. The anticipated outcomes include enhanced teaching methodologies that leverage AI and ICT, improved student engagement, and increased capacity among educators to deliver inclusive and sustainable education. Overall, this project seeks to encourage educational professionals equipping educators in the target country with innovative tools and strategies to meet evolving global challenges.
